blocks.t: GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR "SPACE WALK"
INSTALLATION:
1. Remove shipping cleats located on the bottom of the cabinet.
2. Install (4) provided leg levelers to bottom of cabinet and level cabinet.

3. The power is controlled by a switch located on top of the cabinet Plug into A.C. only, 115 volts, 60 cycles. In low line areas (105 volts or less) a boost in the output voltage of the transformer may be obtained by removing the wire from the 115 volt top of the transformer and rewiring to the 105 volt position.
VOLTAGE CONTROL POT:
Located on Power Supply (P.C. 0080-00904F) and is preset at the factory. These pots should not be tampered with unless the Distributor Service Department is contacted.
METHOD OF PLAY ADJUSTMENT SWITCHES:
Time, Coin, Extended Piay, Alignment and Test Switches located on Game Logic Board (P.C. A084~90700-D640) and may be adjusted as indicated on seperate instruction sheet in back box area.
TO SERVICE CONTROL PANEL POTS:
1. Remove Control Panel Cable pack from Game Logic Board.
2. Open front coin door and release (2) clamps located on each side of cabinet wall through door opening.
3. Remove wire nut between Main Cable and Control Panel Cable through front door.
4. Remove Control Panel and service same.
SPRINGBOARD ALIGNMENT:
1. Place Springboard Alignment Switch #7 in "off" position.
2. Close Slam Tilt Switch on Front Door Assembly. Alignment pattern will be displayed on Monitor Screen.
3. Rotate Pots A, B, C and D located on Game Logic Board (P.C. A084-90700- D640) to center position as indicated by arrow on pot faces.
4. Adjust each players Control Pot (located on Control] Panel) to travel from approximately 1K ohms (lower limit) to 9.5K ohms (upper limit).

5. Rotate player 1 Control Pot to left extremity. If Springboard does not touch edge of alignment pattern trim the travel by rotating Pot "B" (500 ohm) until it does. If Springboard over travels left edge of alignment pattern, rotate Pot "B" in opposite direction.

6. Rotate Player 1 Control Pot to right extremity. If Springboard does not touch edge of alignment pattern, trim the travel by rotating Pot "A" (5K ohm) until it does. If Springboard over travels right edge of alignment pattern, rotate Pot "A" in opposite direction.
SPRINGBOARD ALIGNMENT (cont'd):
7. Repeat steps 5 and 6 using player 2 Control Pot. Pot "C" (5K ohms) controls left edge trim. Pot "D" controls right edge trim.
Reset Springboard Alignment Switch #7 te "on" position and close Slam Tilt Switch. (See sketch below for pot locations.)
RAM/ROM TEST:
2. Place Switch #8 in "off" position.
Close Slam Tilt Switch to initiate test.
Reset Switch #8 to "on" position and close Tilt Switch when test has been completed.
VOLUME CONTROL POT:
Located on Game Logic Board (P.C. AO84~-90700-D640) raises or lowers all sounds and may be adjusted by rotating Pot "E" as desired.
TONE CONTROL POT:
Located on Game Logic Board (P.C. A084-90700-D640) varies all tones as desired by rotating Pot "F".
TO REPLACE DISPLAY GLASS LAMPS:
Remove upper back door. Lamp socket mounting screws are readily accessible through back door opening.
